semantic_fidelity.reason: All 28 expected endpoint pairs are specified, but the four BL→spine routes in v3 cannot be individually paired reliably from stems to heads in the capture; required rendered coverage is therefore not established. v4 repeats only e21–e28, not those four.

arrow_traceability.reason: In v3 BL→spine outer-rail paths wind through 15 bridges and adjacent bends; individual pairings cannot be traced without guessing. v4 detail reduces crowding for e21–e28 but does not cover e17–e20.

layout_fit.reason: All four final-spec 77×47 natural dumps fit, but the required split coverage includes four visually untraceable BL→spine routes. Attempts do not establish that all 15 crossings are unavoidable across all allowed layouts; touching bends alone are not crossings.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Source tier names remain readable in labels and spatial ranks; related siblings share hues/order, and no group container is drawn. v3 pins honor source correction.

category_fit.reason: Correct family redundant-fabrics, source-backed line and visible double target ports, static lanes, stated secondary mesh rule and honored fabric pins. The recipe also requires individually traceable lanes; BL→spine lanes in the only view remain untraceable. Recorded attempts demonstrate serious router constraints but do not establish that no permitted alternative or separate BL→spine detail could make them traceable. Thus the unmet central recipe has not been evidenced as yielding.
category_fit.evidence_line: all 28 links over 18 devices are tier-to-tier cross-connects where every lower target carries a double arrowhead (2 ISPs per MUX, 2 MUXes x 2 cores, 2 cores x 2 firewalls, 2 firewalls x 2 border leaves, 2 border leaves x 2 spines, 2 spines x 2 rack leaves, 2 rack leaves x 2 racks) and the source says 'remove the dots flowing for now' — densest family, double-arrowhead targets, dots forbidden.

border_integrity.reason: Complete sides/corners and per-node consistent color verified for all 28 normal and 28 select-all node borders in ANSI; control palette does not overwrite node borders. Select-all is simultaneous, not 28 separate interactions.

workflow_evidence.reason: All 15 wrapper records have raw stdout/stderr matching recorded hashes; validators report records complete, pane headers and cleanup exist, and blind record precedes reveal. But v1-a1 command references mutable views/v1.json, now byte-identical to a3 rather than preserved a1, and the record lacks executed spec hash; a1 snapshot is not cryptographically bound to its executed input. Actual reviewer worker name is not exposed; session ID and mandated model are known. These are evidence gaps, not fabrication.

animation.reason: Explicit source request removes dots; 5 live-pane text frames per view and 3 pinned 77×47 frames are static, checks report zero dots. Motion/origin/arrival not applicable to absent dots.

findings.description: DEFECT: independent BL→spine links cannot be individually followed confidently in v3; long outer rail detours pass many bridge/touch clusters. v4 does not cover them.
DEFECT: source relations are declared but not reliably rendered as individually readable complete coverage; do not infer endpoints solely from spec.
DEFECT: fit proof is present, but all split views must provide complete readable coverage; v3 fails that coverage.
DEFECT: correct fabric family and pinned tiers, but central independent-traceable-lane recipe is unmet, without proof no alternative detail can yield it.

DEFECT: 3 ambiguous label owners in v3 and 1 in v4 per checks/validators. Exact affected label identities are not recorded; the nearby measured labels and routes show plausible ambiguity. Recorded attempts and failed slot probe do not prove all possible placements impossible.

EVIDENCE GAP: v1-a1 wrapper command used mutable final path views/v1.json, now a3; log has no executed-spec hash. The separately saved a1 file and output hashes do not bind that exact snapshot to the invocation. All raw hashes are valid.

blockers: Renderer-level: backward pinned BL→spine routes are forced around outer rails in measured v3 attempts, producing high crossing counts.
Renderer-level: minlen exceeding pinned gaps produces pin conflicts.
Renderer-level: label_slot on tested fan caused no obstacle-safe route; with minlen it skipped a label.
Renderer-level: isolated tested 2×2 fan retained one bridge. This measured probe does not prove global mathematical impossibility of all layouts.
Evidence gap: records do not cryptographically bind the executed v1-a1 mutable-path spec to its preserved attempt snapshot.
Evidence gap: reviewer session exposes model and session ID but no worker display name; worker_id is null rather than invented.
